name: Hero Quote
description: A full-bleed photo under a soft dark wash, with a big centred italic headline and a small capitals line beneath.
bestFor: a single strong photo with a few words
photoTip: Any strong frame works; the wash keeps the words readable. Faces in the middle third may sit behind the headline, so set the focus to move them.

tones.note: The tone colours the words. Use light tones (cream, sand) on photos.

fields.label: Headline
fields.hint: Short and evocative. Shrinks to fit; one to five words reads biggest.

fields.label: Small line
fields.hint: Optional. Shown in capitals under the headline. Leave empty to hide.
